name: Night on the Milky Way
subtitle: 5★ Light Cone · Erudition
raw_text: If you are concerned for the road, just look up again. When the stars look gently down, the heart would already be soaring. Every thought and every whisper, becomes a life experience that would never leave.
short_text: Look up at the stars when the road ahead feels impossible — every thought and whisper you carry becomes a memory that never truly leaves.

name: But the Battle Isn't Over
subtitle: Light Cone · Harmony
raw_text: "Remember, the war with the monsters cannot be won by retreating." "We are the last defense, the final iron wall between them and Belobog..." "We cannot retreat under any circumstances!" She looks up to see the frozen earth and endless winter ahead. Business as usual. Only that... the figure at which she had been gazing is gone.
short_text: Bronya vows Belobog cannot fall, standing as the last wall between its people and the monsters outside — then turns to find the person she was watching over already gone.

name: Something Irreplaceable
subtitle: Light Cone
raw_text: "Should a day come when even I'm not here anymore, please look after this database, Svarog." (Who is this... Why is this message in my records...) "Do you have something that's irreplaceable, Svarog?" (Irreplaceable... broken parts... can simply be replaced...) "You'll definitely find it one day, Svarog." (Such things... will only cause trouble...) "When that time comes... You should leave this place behind."
short_text: In a hidden dialogue between Clara and the robot Svarog, a simple question — what's truly irreplaceable? — becomes a quiet meditation on loss and letting go.

name: In the Night
subtitle: 5★ Light Cone · The Hunt
raw_text: A young girl smiles subtly. "How?" "Right here, right now, I am alone..." "But it feels... very lively."
short_text: Alone in the dark, a girl smiles and admits something surprising: being by herself, right here and now, somehow still feels full of life.

name: Time Waits for No One
subtitle: Light Cone
raw_text: She had spent many days next to the window. Flowers were blooming outside when she made gentle medicines with mint and nepeta. Rain was falling outside when she made strong medicines with mosla and ginger. Leaves were falling outside when she made sour medicines with peony roots and dry plums. And snow was falling outside when she made bitter medicines with skullcaps and anemarrhena. Time flows endlessly, but this window and the person sitting next to it remain forever the same.
short_text: Through blooming flowers, falling rain, and falling snow, a healer keeps making medicine by the same window — proof that some devotion never changes, no matter how much time passes.

name: Genius of Brilliant Stars
subtitle: Relic Set
raw_text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that among members of the Genius Society, there is an overabundance of eccentricity and a lack of communication. Social interaction is indeed a burden for most people, even more so for geniuses traveling between worlds...
short_text: A genius once built the ultimate device to connect every isolated mind in the Genius Society across the stars — and almost nobody wanted to use it.

name: Pioneer Diver of Dead Waters
subtitle: Relic Set
raw_text: "I never thought I would meet anyone similar to me. You've walked so much further on this road than me. Therefore, you will surely walk with me till the end, right?"
short_text: Two kindred souls accept that their story ends the same way — as a shallow puddle of dead water — but choose to keep pushing forward anyway, further than anyone before them.

name: Talia: Kingdom of Banditry
subtitle: Relic Set
raw_text: Interstellar thieves came to Talia in their hasty escape from the pursuit of the Galaxy Ranger, and Talia was initially just a desolate place known as the Starry Junkyard...
short_text: Escaped thieves fleeing a Galaxy Ranger crash-landed on a radioactive junkyard world — and slowly built a bustling bandit kingdom out of literal trash.

name: Firmament Frontline: Glamoth
subtitle: Relic Set
raw_text: The Welkin Empire of Glamoth enjoyed a vast territory spanning tens of thousands of light-years, ambitiously setting its sight on the cosmos. At the height of the empire's power, Her Majesty Empress Titania built a magnificent fleet...
short_text: An empire that once dreamed of uniting the galaxy was nearly wiped out by an endless insectoid swarm — until mysterious iron knights fell from the sky and turned the tide.

name: Knight of Purity Palace
subtitle: Relic Set
raw_text: The Solemn Knight had never taken off her hard and heavy casque before anybody. Safina's religious solemnity and silence projected an unbearable air of intimidation...
short_text: A church raised a captured devil from birth to become its most feared and loyal knight — hiding her true nature behind a helmet she's never once removed.
